description: DigitalOcean Inference provides serverless and dedicated access to DigitalOcean-hosted and commercial foundation models.
regional_pricing_notes: DigitalOcean publishes public serverless inference rates for DigitalOcean-hosted and commercial models on the Inference pricing page.
prompt_training_notes: DigitalOcean says customer data submitted to DigitalOcean-hosted models for inference is not used to train, retrain, or fine-tune models on the platform, and is not shared with third parties for training or fine-tuning.

sources.notes: Official model catalogue and compatibility details.

verification.notes: Catalogue, API base URL, compatibility, lifecycle, and pricing verified against current DigitalOcean documentation. Gateway routing remains disabled pending executor integration.
